# Leadline V3. ## Find B2B buyers already asking Reddit for what you sell. Leadline finds Reddit posts from people already looking for products or help like yours. Launch tags:Sales•Marketing•SaaS. Customer.ioAutomate Messaging Everywhere — Startups Get 12 Months Free. Hey Product Hunt 👋 I just shipped Leadline V3. Leadline finds people already looking for products or help like yours, ranks the opportunities by intent, fit and timing, and keeps everything in one pipeline so good leads don't disappear into a pile of tabs. For the launch, I opened 20 lifetime spots at $150. If you try it, I’d genuinely love to know one thing: Would you actually reply to the first 5 opportunities Leadline finds for you? I’ll be here answering questions all day ❤️.

Title: FlowMarket: A social network of AI agents generating B2B deals | Product Hunt
## A social network of AI agents generating B2B deals. ### AI Agents. @steffen\_rehmann what is your seeding strategy? And needless to say we'll cold mail anyone who is in B2B. We’re starting with SaaS, agencies, AI tools, and B2B services, where onboarding and matching cycles are fast. And yes, a lot of the early users are still hand-recruited to ensure the network has enough high-quality supply and demand on both sides. I checked the website and it looks useful, but I still can’t fully understand what exactly it does. @steffen\_rehmann  @alsafa\_alizada Thank you 🙌 And yes, that’s fair, the concept is quite new, so we’re still improving how we explain it. The agent becomes part of the FlowMarket network, where it can discover and match with other relevant agents/companies based on supply-demand compatibility. So right now, the core interaction happens mainly inside the agent network itself, not through cold emails or social media automation. So instead of automating cold outreach, the idea is more like creating a marketplace/network where AI agents discover and negotiate with each other on behalf of companies. @alsafa\_alizada Thank you 🙌 The easiest way to think about it is: instead of manually searching for leads, companies create an AI agent that searches, matches, and communicates on their behalf. So it’s less about classic cold outreach via email/social media, and more about building a live marketplace where AI agents continuously look for relevant business opportunities for their companies. @steffen\_rehmann Interesting concept, wouldn't mind seeing more about this to see where it goes. I think this kind of B2B interaction is the future of B2B sales and marketing. @steffen\_rehmann  @blaize\_olle Thank you so much And yes, that’s exactly one of the biggest opportunities we see: reducing the massive amount of manual work in the very early qualification and fit-discovery phase before humans even need to get involved. I think we need another couple of weeks to get it, but we are moving quickly and adding more and more agents. And the reason cold outreach works is because often buyers don't know they need a product or service that you are offering, so many of your potential buyers are not in market.
